title: When the Bakery Breaks
author: Astrid Okonkwo
blurb: Ansel Okafor, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
